My name is NAYLA RONDINA I'm 39 years old. Height 1,73 . 60 kg. I'm from BARILOCHE -PATAGONIA ARGENTINA. I'm ski and snowboard instructor. My nickname is NAY.
I have this certifications: The only Argentinian woman to have both highest level certifications skiing and snowboarding Bodybuilding instructor and personal trainer Judge in USA - CANADA -SOUTH AMERICA freeride competitions Trainer of the Argentina national demo team.
I love CARVING and training in the GYM. Life at the mountains is my world.
My goals : Empower and make people grow in their physical and technical capacity. Awards: Win South American Synchro Championship (first) Patagonia Argentina-Chapelco Win World championship Ski Syncro "Divas" Aspen Colorado- United States of America

settings.heading: Q1：Your recent Venustas heated apparel.
settings.body: A: I recently tried out Venustas heated vests to wear under our ski jackets on cold days. They help give you that extra bit of heat on cold lift rides.They also work great for outdoor hikes and walking on cold days.

settings.heading: Q2: How does Venustas heated apparel change your lifestyle?
settings.body: A: Venustas has completely changed the cold days at work. Being a ski instructor is incredible but there are very harsh winter days. Days in which, before Venustas, my back was completely stiff from the cold.

settings.heading: Q3: Which part most appealing to you about Venustas?
settings.body: A: Venustas maintain the temperature of the body, feel my neck, my back and my chest even in very low temperatures. Keeping warm all my uper body.

settings.heading: Q4: The reason to be our V+ Master.
settings.body: A: I am a visible face to many people of good economic position and guide towards them. People continually ask for advice on what to wear in low temperatures, they tend to imitate me in the things I use to enjoy sports and the mountains and as a professional skier I advise them by providing information and guidance on what to buy. I am influential in your purchase decision. My co-workers may also know the brand since I work with more than 800 instructors in Aspen and more than 1000 in Argentina, they have recommended the brand through me and have bought them too. We can create a very good network because of the sport that I do, which is double winter, winter all year round. naylarondina's profile picture
